title: Chat Prompts and Messages with LangChain
learning_objectives: Build chat prompts with ChatPromptTemplate and MessagesPlaceholder
Represent conversations as SystemMessage, HumanMessage and AIMessage objects
Compose prompt | model | output parser chains and test them with a fake chat model
entry_point: make_tutor_prompt(); format_chat(prompt, subject, max_words, history, question); ask(prompt, model, subject, max_words, history, question)
hints: Write a helper that turns the history pairs into message objects and builds the input dict.

failure_feedback.advice: The template needs subject, max_words, history and question.
System message, then the history placeholder, then the human question.
Compose prompt | model | StrOutputParser() and invoke it.
Only 'human' and 'ai' roles are allowed in the history.
